description: Participating in an industry-oriented training program focused on Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, and Generative AI technologies. Gaining hands-on experience in data analysis, model development, prompt engineering, and real-world AI applications through practical projects and mentorship from industry experts.

Conducted research and experimentation with machine learning models to extract data-driven insights. Performed exploratory data analysis using Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib, and optimized models through hyperparameter tuning to improve prediction accuracy.

Worked on data preprocessing and exploratory data analysis. Built and evaluated classification models using Scikit-learn with feature scaling, cross-validation, and performance evaluation metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and confusion matrix.

Developed Java-based applications using object-oriented programming principles. Worked on backend logic, debugging, and writing efficient, modular code while gaining exposure to real-world software development practices.
